title_en: Do Not Hold On to Me, Done, Donka
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: 'Доне, Донке' is a repeated vocative on a name (Donka); 'Ни година не пројде' is my reading of 'not even a year passed'. Could not confirm whether this is anonymous folk or a composed song.

words_to_learn.en: do not hold on / do not grab

lines.cyr: Не се фаќај Доне, Донке до мене
lines.lat: Ne se faḱaj Done, Donke do mene
lines.en: Do not hold on to me, Done, Donka,

lines.cyr: срце ми прегоре Донке за тебе.
lines.lat: srce mi pregore Donke za tebe.
lines.en: my heart burned up for you, Donka.

lines.cyr: Еј што те заљубив
lines.lat: Ej što te zaljubiv
lines.en: Hey, why did I fall in love with you,

lines.cyr: е, е, еј па те изгубив.
lines.lat: e, e, ej pa te izgubiv.
lines.en: oh, oh, hey, and then lose you.

lines.cyr: Кога војник Доне, Донке јас одев
lines.lat: Koga vojnik Done, Donke jas odev
lines.en: When I went off as a soldier, Done, Donka,

lines.cyr: ти орото Доне, Донке го водеше.
lines.lat: ti oroto Done, Donke go vodeše.
lines.en: you led the oro, Done, Donka.

lines.cyr: Еј, што те заљубив
lines.lat: Ej, što te zaljubiv
lines.en: Hey, why did I fall in love with you,

lines.cyr: е, еј па те изгубив.
lines.lat: e, ej pa te izgubiv.
lines.en: oh, hey, and then lose you.

lines.cyr: Ти до мене Доне, Донке заигра,
lines.lat: Ti do mene Done, Donke zaigra,
lines.en: You started dancing next to me, Done, Donka,

lines.cyr: срцето ми Доне, Донке разигра.
lines.lat: srceto mi Done, Donke razigra.
lines.en: you set my heart dancing, Done, Donka.

lines.cyr: Тогај збор ми Доне, Донке ти даде
lines.lat: Togaj zbor mi Done, Donke ti dade
lines.en: Then you gave me your word, Done, Donka,

lines.cyr: по година срцето си продаде.
lines.lat: po godina srceto si prodade.
lines.en: after a year you sold your heart.

lines.cyr: Еј што те заљубив
lines.lat: Ej što te zaljubiv
lines.en: Hey, why did I fall in love with you,

lines.cyr: е, е, еј па те изгубив.
lines.lat: e, e, ej pa te izgubiv.
lines.en: oh, oh, hey, and then lose you.

lines.cyr: Ни година Доне, Донке не пројде
lines.lat: Ni godina Done, Donke ne projde
lines.en: Not even a year passed, Done, Donka,

lines.cyr: за другого Доне, Донке си појде.
lines.lat: za drugogo Done, Donke si pojde.
lines.en: and you went off to another, Done, Donka.

lines.cyr: Не ме играј Доне, Донке не збори
lines.lat: Ne me igraj Done, Donke ne zbori
lines.en: Do not dance with me, Done, Donka, do not talk,

lines.cyr: оти знаеш Доне, Донке што стори.
lines.lat: oti znaeš Done, Donke što stori.
lines.en: because you know, Done, Donka, what you did.

lines.cyr: Еј што те заљубив
lines.lat: Ej što te zaljubiv
lines.en: Hey, why did I fall in love with you,

lines.cyr: е, е, еј па те изгубив.
lines.lat: e, e, ej pa te izgubiv.
lines.en: oh, oh, hey, and then lose you.

lines.cyr: Тргни рака Доне, Донке од мене
lines.lat: Trgni raka Done, Donke od mene
lines.en: Pull your hand away, Done, Donka, from me,

lines.cyr: срце веќе не ми игра за тебе.
lines.lat: srce veḱe ne mi igra za tebe.
lines.en: my heart no longer dances for you.
